# Jake's Resume

- Source: https://github.com/jakegut/resume (file `resume.tex`, fetched 2026-11-01 from
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jakegut/resume/master/resume.tex)
- Licence: MIT, Copyright (c) 2020 Jake Gutierrez; full text in `LICENSE`.
- `original/resume.tex` is the file as published.
- `template.tex`: header block added; the preamble is unchanged; the body's sample content is
  replaced by `\VAR{}`/`\BLOCK{}`. Education's location column is left empty because the profile
  has no education location.
